description: The line plot illustrates the MRR@10 performance of various DPR (Dense Passage Retrieval) variants as a function of the number of queries used during inference, denoted as S, which ranges from 1 to 10 on a linear x-axis. The y-axis, labeled “MRR@10,” spans from 33.0 to 36.5, also on a linear scale, with major tick marks every 0.5 units. Six distinct lines represent different DPR configurations: “DPR w/ gold” (black solid line) remains flat at approximately 34.8 across all S values; “DPR w/ top-1” (green solid line with circle markers) starts at 33.0 when S=1, rises sharply to 35.5 at S=4, and continues increasing to 36.4 at S=10; “DPR w/ bottom-1” (purple solid line with circle markers) begins at 34.8, dips slightly to 34.7 at S=4, and stabilizes near 34.7–34.8; “DPR w/ random” (blue solid line with circle markers) starts at 34.8, peaks at 35.7 at S=4, then gently declines to 35.6 at S=10; “DPR w/ curriculum” (red solid line with circle markers) begins at 35.6, rises to 35.9 at S=4, and plateaus near 35.8–35.9; and “DPR w/ gold” is also represented by a dashed black line at 34.8, while “DPR w/ bottom-1” is also shown with a dashed purple line at 34.7, likely indicating baseline or reference levels. The legend in the lower right identifies each line by color, marker, and label.
